name: OmaVLESS
author: kdk
description: OmaVLESS is a VPN app for Omarchy that puts everyday connection controls directly in the bar. Import your own compatible VLESS profile or HTTPS subscription, choose Full VPN, Routing or Direct, connect to a profile, switch profiles, or disconnect, and refresh subscription server lists. Free and open source; VPN servers and service subscriptions are not included.

barWidget.description: Connect from the bar, import your own compatible profiles and subscriptions, choose routing modes and refresh server lists. Includes profile management, English/Russian UI and privacy-safe support reports.

schema.label: Ping host (empty disables the latency probe)
